description: Liquid call rows from a real NVDA chain, 2026-08-17, used as a golden test for our own pricing. If our implied vol and greeks cannot reproduce a broker's for contracts this liquid, every feature and label downstream is suspect. Greeks are in broker display units: vega per vol point, theta per calendar day.
note: Rate and dividend yield are our assumptions, not the broker's. NVDA's yield is ~0.02% and two days of carry is negligible, so both are near-irrelevant at this tenor — which is precisely why this expiry makes a clean test of the vol solver itself.
